notes.title: Hotfix Update – August 20, 2025
notes.notes:
Hello,

This is the Before the Dawn development team.

In this hotfix, we’ve applied several updates to improve the gameplay experience and UI usability.

Please see the detailed update notes below.




📌 Key Updates
Adjusted certain monster spawn locations and roaming points.

Improved visual effects related to sanity loss to enhance fear and immersion.

Improved the behavior of settings option UI.

Optimized the functionality of certain features within the UI options menu.

Enhanced overall usability for UI and cursor control, including controller support.

Adjusted certain HUD display rules.


🐞 Bug Fixes
Fixed an issue where certain achievements could be cleared abnormally in specific situations.

Fixed an issue where some controller tutorials were not displaying correctly.
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]Thank you as always for playing.
[p align="start"]Your feedback is a great help in making Before the Dawn even more polished.
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]Sincerely, — The Before the Dawn Development Team

notes.title: 📢 Major Update Announcement – Before the Dawn: SENARA Prologue
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119946/436f3b1381958e3562b06c74c08edfceafcdff60.jpg"]

Hello, this is Influsion Studio.



One year after its initial release, SAVE Teaser: Before the Dawn has returned with a major update and has been reborn as Before the Dawn: SENARA Prologue.



This update goes beyond simple improvements — it is an expanded version that elevates the overall quality of the game and marks an important milestone that sets the direction for the series.

With this update, the quality of graphics, sound, and systems has been significantly enhanced, and new content and improved gameplay, previously unavailable, have been added.

Through these changes, players will experience deeper immersion and heightened tension, while also getting an early taste of the atmosphere and gameplay style of the upcoming SENARA: The Sacrament.



Before the Dawn: SENARA Prologue is more than just a prologue; it is the first step on a journey that heralds the beginning of the series’ universe.




Why did we undertake this major update?


① To meet the expectations for expanding the game’s universe

Players who enjoyed SAVE and SAVE Teaser were curious about the incidents and background surrounding the SENARA ship and the SENARA Gospel Church Mission.

While we had prepared various stories, it was difficult to convey everything within the existing game, so we aimed to quench this curiosity by adding new content.



② To connect to the new title, SENARA: The Sacrament
To overcome these limitations, we began developing a spin-off new title, SENARA: The Sacrament, which explores different perspectives and events within the same universe.

This new game, a story-driven first-person survival horror, is being developed with a unique atmosphere, immersive storytelling, and multiple endings to offer players a deeply engaging experience.



③ To give players an early experience of the new world and systems
Ahead of the full release of SENARA: The Sacrament, we conducted a major update based on the free prologue released one year ago so players can try out some of the new content and systems we have prepared so far.

With new features, enhanced visuals, and improved gameplay, the overall quality has been significantly elevated.




Introduction to Before the Dawn: SENARA Prologue
In this prologue, experience the escape of a lone survivor trapped in crisis while uncovering the truth behind a fanatical cult, all set within a meticulously recreated environment based on the real 6,000-ton SENARA ship.

With this update, we have improved various elements such as the map and journal and added new content to faithfully capture the essence of a first-person survival horror game.

Explore the confined ship, search for clues, and evade the watchers’ eyes as you get closer to uncovering the truth behind the incident — play and experience it yourself.




Brief Introduction to SENARA: The Sacrament
SENARA: The Sacrament is a story-driven first-person survival horror set aboard a large ship, exploring themes of faith, fanaticism, and abyssal terror.

Players find themselves mysteriously left alone on the SENARA, forced to survive and escape as the ship faces the threat of sinking.

Survivors with various motives, forbidden cult rituals, and hidden truths await you.



🎯 Add the game to your wishlist on the store page now and stay updated with the latest news.



[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3915120/SENARA_The_Sacrament"][/dynamiclink]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119946/a8c5d019600e0d8b33671b4fccfd118a48461b1e.jpg"]


In closing,
We sincerely thank all of you who have supported and loved the SAVE and SENARA series.

Through this update of Before the Dawn: SENARA Prologue, we hope you experience even deeper fear and immersion, and we look forward to growing together with you.

If you have any questions or concerns while playing, please share them in our community.

Your valuable feedback is a great help in making the game better.

We appreciate your continued support and enthusiasm!



— From all of us at Influsion Studio
